units.source_text: 写到这里，似乎半途停止了，笔迹也乱七八糟。

en.t: At this point the writing seemed to have stopped halfway, and the handwriting was in complete disorder.
The envelope was addressed: "To the Lady Attendant."

units.source_text: 这只袋子已经成了蠹鱼的栖身之所。

en.t: This bag had already become a dwelling place for silverfish.
The letter paper was old, and the smell of mildew struck the nose.

units.source_text: 然而字迹并不模糊，与新近写的无异。

en.t: Yet the handwriting was not blurred, and looked no different from something written recently.

units.source_text: 文句也很清楚，可以仔细阅读。

en.t: The wording too was clear, and it could be read carefully.

units.source_text: 薰君想道：“正如弁君所言，万一散失，落入别人手中，如何是好！

en.t: Kaoru thought, "Just as Ben no Kimi said, if by some chance these were scattered and fell into someone else's hands, what could be done!

units.source_text: 此种事情，恐是世间独一无二的了。”

en.t: Such a thing is probably unique in all the world."

units.source_text: 他独自伤心，越来越觉悲痛。

en.t: He grieved alone, feeling more and more sorrowful.

units.source_text: 本拟入宫，终因心绪不佳，未能如愿。

en.t: He had meant to go to court, but in the end, because his spirits were so low, he could not do as he had planned.

units.source_text: 他去参见母亲，但见三公主抖擞精神，正在一心不乱地诵经。

en.t: He went to see his mother, and found the Third Princess rousing herself and reciting sutras with single-minded concentration.

units.source_text: 看见他来，似觉难于为情，藏过了经卷。

en.t: When she saw him come, she seemed embarrassed and put the sutra scrolls away.

units.source_text: 薰君想道：“我又何必向母亲表示我已知道这秘密呢！”

en.t: Kaoru thought, "Why should I let my mother know that I have learned this secret?"

units.source_text: 他只得将此事秘藏在心中，独自悲伤叹息。

en.t: He could only hide the matter deep in his heart, grieving and sighing alone.
